Elevation of national martyrs and patronal feasts (e.g. Vietnamese Martyrs Nov 24 to Solemnity; Cabrini Nov 13 to Memorial).
Structural calendar differences between Missale Romanum 1962 (Pre-Lenten Septuagesima, Passiontide veiling, Octave of Pentecost, Christ the King in October) and 1969 Paul VI Missal.
